name: usage-guard
description: Winds sessions and subagents down before the 5-hour or 7-day subscription limit: one wind-down note per band, a handoff file, spawn and loop denies near the limit, optional resume after the reset

warn5h.title: WARN at 5-hour %
warn5h.description: Tell every agent to finish the current step and write a handoff once the 5-hour window reaches this percent

warn7d.title: WARN at 7-day %
warn7d.description: Same as above, for the 7-day window

hard5h.title: HARD at 5-hour %
hard5h.description: Deny new subagents, workflows and loop wakeups, and tell running subagents to return now

hard7d.title: HARD at 7-day %
hard7d.description: Same as above, for the 7-day window

autoResume.title: Resume after reset
autoResume.description: When a window resets, submit one 'continue from the handoff' prompt in sessions this plugin wound down (0 to 5 min random delay)
